name: Prepare quarterly financial statements
summary: For the first three quarters of each fiscal year the fund must send condensed financial statements to the federal and provincial finance ministers within 45 days of quarter end and publish them within seven days after that. Fund accounting rolls forward the templates, waits for the approved quarter-end net asset value, maps the trial balance to statement lines for the base and additional plan accounts, prepares the notes with inputs from Valuations, Performance and Legal, and drafts the results commentary. The package is tied out and reviewed by the director, controller and CFRO, reviewed by the Audit Committee, translated into French, laid out and published with the results release. The wait for quarter-end private valuations leaves about two weeks for all of this.

baseline.org_archetype: A very large Canadian public pension investment manager that publishes quarterly statements for one fund with base and additional plan accounts.
baseline.notes: The fourth quarter is covered by the annual report process. Fund accounting and financial reporting has about 75 people who also run daily accounting, the monthly close and the audit.

trigger: The first, second or third quarter of the fiscal year ends; drafting of figures starts when the monthly close delivers the approved quarter-end net asset value.
end_state: The statements have been sent to the ministers and published in English and French with the results release.

volume.seasonality: Three statements a year, for quarters ending June 30, September 30 and December 31; work peaks in weeks four to six after quarter end.

evidence.note: the fund's governing act s. 50(1) requires statements for the first, second and third quarters.

steps.name: Issue the quarterly reporting timetable and assign sections
steps.description: At quarter end the fund accounting director confirms the timetable back from the 45-day deadline (NAV date, drafts, reviews, Audit Committee date, translation, release date agreed with Public Affairs) and assigns statements and notes to accountants.

evidence.note: Timetable set back from the statutory 45-day limit; releases came 41 to 44 days after quarter end. Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Roll forward the statement templates, notes and comparatives
steps.description: A senior associate copies last quarter's statement file, updates dates and headings, inserts the prior-year same-quarter and year-to-date comparatives for the base plan, additional plan and total columns, and flags notes that need new wording for events in the quarter.

error.defect_description: A comparative figure or heading is not updated.

evidence.note: Quarterly statements need year-to-date comparison with the prior year and separate base and additional plan figures; IAS 34 condensed statements with comparatives. Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Send information requests to input owners
steps.description: The senior associate sends requests with due dates to Valuations (Level 3 disclosures), Performance (returns), Treasury (debt and financing), Legal (commitments and contingencies), Tax and Risk, using last quarter's templates.

evidence.note: Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Receive the approved quarter-end NAV and trial balance
steps.description: When the controller approves the quarter-end close, the senior associate pulls the final trial balance and net asset value for the base and additional plan accounts from the book of record and confirms that no late adjustments are pending.

evidence.note: Quarter-end close waits for private valuations approved by the Valuation Committee; the organisation's monthly close workflow puts quarter-end NAV approval about 30 days after quarter end. Wait counted from the information requests.

steps.name: Map the trial balance to statement lines
steps.description: Accountants map ledger accounts to the lines of the condensed statements (net income, changes in net assets, cash flows and financial position) for the base plan, additional plan and total, and reconcile totals to the approved NAV.

error.defect_description: Account mapped to the wrong line or account.

evidence.note: Joint and separate statements for base and additional plan; quarterly and annual schedules prepared by the investment and fund accounting team. Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Prepare the note schedules
steps.description: Accountants prepare the note tables: investments by asset class, fair value hierarchy and Level 3 movements, investment holding subsidiaries, derivatives, debt and financing, commitments and guarantees, and plan transfers, each tied to ledger or sub-ledger data.

error.defect_description: A note table does not agree to the statements or prior period.

evidence.note: IAS 34 selected explanatory notes; the annual statements' notes on fair value hierarchy, Level 3 reconciliation and investment holding subsidiaries set the content. Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Provide Level 3 valuation technique and sensitivity tables
steps.description: A senior valuation professional fills in the table of valuation techniques, unobservable input ranges and the sensitivity of Level 3 values to reasonable alternative assumptions, from the approved quarter-end valuations.

error.defect_description: Input ranges not updated for the quarter.

evidence.note: Level 3 investments are valued with unobservable inputs and disclosed with sensitivities in the annual statements. Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Provide quarterly and multi-year returns for the commentary
steps.description: A performance senior associate sends the quarter's net return, five- and ten-year annualised returns and net income by account for the base and additional plan, reconciled to the NAV.

evidence.note: Releases report quarterly, five-year and ten-year net returns for both accounts. Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Confirm commitments, contingencies and subsequent events with Legal
steps.description: Legal counsel answers the quarterly inquiry on new guarantees, indemnities, litigation and commitments signed in the quarter, and on significant transactions after quarter end that may need disclosure.

evidence.note: Standard quarterly legal inquiry practice; Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Draft the results commentary and key figures
steps.description: The senior associate drafts the results commentary and a key figures sheet (net assets, net income, net contributions, returns by account and since inception) that Public Affairs uses for the news release and presentation.

error.defect_description: A figure in the commentary does not match the statements.

evidence.note: Quarterly statements are published with related news releases. Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Tie out the statements, notes and commentary
steps.description: The senior associate casts every table, ticks each figure to the trial balance, sub-ledger schedules and the returns schedule, checks cross-references between statements and notes, and documents the tie-out as evidence of the control.

control.basis: Internal control over financial reporting (COSO 2013): independent tie-out of published statements, evaluated by the CEO and CFRO and audited by the external auditor

evidence.note: Internal control over financial reporting under COSO 2013, certified by the CEO and CFRO. Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Correct the drafts and re-check changed items
steps.description: An accountant corrects mapping, note or commentary errors raised by the tie-out or a reviewer, re-ticks the changed figures and updates the open-points log.

evidence.note: Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Review the full draft package
steps.description: The director reads the statements, notes and commentary, compares movements with last quarter and the NAV pack, challenges unusual items and sends review points back or passes the package to the controller.

control.basis: Preparer and reviewer sign-off on published financial statements within internal control over financial reporting

evidence.note: Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Controller review and sign-off
steps.description: The managing director and controller reviews the package, key judgments and disclosure changes, and signs off or sends points back.

evidence.note: Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: CFRO review and approval
steps.description: The Chief Financial and Risk Officer reads the statements and commentary, tests key messages against the results narrative and approves the package for the Audit Committee and translation.

control.basis: Financial reporting policy: CFRO approval before Audit Committee review

evidence.note: The CFRO meets the Audit Committee and supervises the evaluation of financial reporting controls. Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Send the approved draft for French translation
steps.description: The senior associate sends the approved English statements and commentary to the translation provider with the glossary of standard terms and the deadline.

evidence.note: Statements are published in both official languages. Use of an outside translation provider is the author's assumption.

steps.name: Prepare and send the Audit Committee materials
steps.description: The director assembles the draft statements, commentary, key judgments, valuation summary and a cover memo, and sends them to the board secretariat for the Audit Committee package on the board portal.

evidence.note: All public financial reports are reviewed by the Audit Committee. Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Audit Committee reviews the quarterly statements
steps.description: The Audit Committee reviews the statements at a meeting or by written circulation, asks management questions and clears them for release, sometimes with drafting comments.

control.basis: Audit Committee review of all public financial reports (organisation practice beyond the fund's governing act s. 31 duties for annual statements)

evidence.note: Audit Committee review of all public financial reports is the organisation's practice; the Act assigns the committee only the annual statements. Wait is the author's estimate.

steps.name: Incorporate Audit Committee comments
steps.description: The senior associate makes the agreed drafting changes in both the statements and the commentary, records them and sends the changed passages to the translator.

evidence.note: Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Receive the French translation
steps.description: The translation provider returns the French statements and commentary, usually while the Audit Committee review is under way, with queries on any terms not in the agreed glossary.

evidence.note: Bilingual publication from the annual report; turnaround is the author's estimate.

steps.name: Check the French version figures and tables
steps.description: The senior associate compares every figure, table and note reference in the French version with the final English text and returns corrections to the translator.

evidence.note: Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Lay out the statements in the publication template
steps.description: A communications specialist places the final English and French text and tables into the designed publication template and produces the PDFs for the website.

error.defect_description: A table or figure is shifted or dropped in layout.

evidence.note: Use of a designed template for the published statements is the author's assumption.

steps.name: Proofread the typeset files against the approved source
steps.description: An accountant proofreads the typeset English and French PDFs against the approved statements, line by line for figures and headings, and sends layout errors back.

control.basis: Internal control over financial reporting: published figures agree to the approved statements

evidence.note: Times are the author's estimates.

steps.name: Send the statements to the federal and provincial finance ministers
steps.description: The director sends the final statements to the federal Minister of Finance and the provincial finance ministers within 45 days of quarter end and keeps evidence of the date sent.

control.basis: the fund's governing act s. 50(1): quarterly statements to the ministers within 45 days after the quarter

evidence.note: the fund's governing act s. 50(1).

steps.name: Publish the statements with the results release
steps.description: A communications specialist posts the English and French statements on the website at the time of the results news release, within seven days of sending them to the ministers.

control.basis: the fund's governing act s. 50(2): quarterly statements made public within seven days after they are sent to the ministers

evidence.note: the fund's governing act s. 50(2); releases on August 13, 2021 and February 10, 2022 linked French versions.

exceptions.name: Tie-out differences
exceptions.description: The tie-out finds statements, notes or commentary that do not agree, and an accountant corrects them before the director's review.

exceptions.name: Reviewer points
exceptions.description: The director, controller or CFRO sends points back for correction and the package is re-reviewed.

exceptions.name: Audit Committee comments
exceptions.description: The committee clears the statements with drafting comments that must be reflected in both languages.

exceptions.name: Late quarter-end NAV
exceptions.description: Late private valuations or close adjustments push the NAV into the last two weeks and the team works on preliminary figures to hold the release date.

benchmarks.unit: calendar days from quarter end to statements sent and published

evidence.note: Results released 44 days (Q1, August 13, 2021) and 41 days (Q3, February 10, 2022) after quarter end; the statutory limit of 45 days caps the 90th percentile.

benchmarks.unit: average days from quarter end to filing
benchmarks.population: About 1,500 US accelerated filers with a 40-day deadline

evidence.note: About half file within a few days of the deadline.

pain_points.description: The approved quarter-end NAV arrives about a month after quarter end because private valuations take that long, leaving about two weeks for statements, reviews, committee, translation and layout.
Note tables are built and tied out in spreadsheets, so corrections ripple through several files.
Several sequential reviews (director, controller, CFRO, Audit Committee) each can send the package back.

evidence.note: Author's judgment.

pain_points.description: Bilingual publication adds translation, checking and a second layout under deadline.

sources.title: Senior Analyst, Group Accounting and Reporting (job posting, the model fund, Toronto)
sources.supports: The Investment and Fund Accounting team runs the period-end close of the investment ledger in SimCorp Dimension, prepares and reviews monthly, quarterly and annual investment and financial schedules and answers audit requests on financial statements and accounting controls

assumptions: The case starts at quarter end with planning steps; the trigger from the monthly close (the approved quarter-end net asset value) arrives at step s04, about 30 days after quarter end, consistent with the organisation's monthly close workflow.

Touch minutes are team person-minutes. Several accountants work notes, schedules and inputs in parallel, but the simulator adds them in sequence, so post-NAV waits are set short to keep elapsed time realistic.
The Audit Committee is outside the organisation (the Board is an external party), so its review is an external wait; the board secretariat's package work is in ex-board-reporting.
Translation by an outside provider and layout by Public Affairs in a designed template are the author's assumptions; the organisation publishes in both official languages.
The external auditor is assumed not to perform a formal review engagement on the quarterly statements; this is not published.
Volume is three statements a year (0.25 a month); fte_on_process averages about 50 hours of work a month across roles. At this volume hands-on time implies about 0.3 FTE.
The simulated 90th percentile can exceed the 45-day statutory limit because the simulator draws each wait independently; in practice the deadline compresses the later steps.

val_senior, perf_senior, legal_counsel, fa_accountant and comms_specialist are organisation roles that the process map does not list for this process; they are added for the inputs and publication steps. The performance team's returns are an input the process map does not show.
Loaded costs per hour are the organisation file's (total compensation scaled to F2022 personnel expense, times an overhead factor of 1.25, divided by 1,950 hours).
